summary.text: Norsk Hydro ASA is a public limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1905-12-02. Its website describes the business as follows: "Hydro is a leading aluminium and renewable energy company that builds businesses and partnerships for a more sustainable future. We have 32,000 employees in more than 140 locations and 40 countries." Its main industry code is 24.420 (produksjon av aluminium). The register shows 391 employees and 11 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 213 281 000 000 NOK and the annual result was 8 304 000 000 NOK; operating income was up from 208 663 000 000 NOK in 2024. Its verified website is hydro.com, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The latest news on its own website is "ALUMINIUM 2026: Hydro invests to strengthen resilience across the aluminium value chain" from 2026-10-06. It has published 11 procurement notices as a buyer. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (549300N1SDN71ZZ8BO45). Recent changes in the register: business address set to Drammensveien 260 on 2026-10-14; employees set to 391 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-06-10.
